title: Doctoral Program in Economics (CDSE)
institution: University of Mannheim, Graduate School of Economic and Social Sciences (GESS), Center for Doctoral Studies in Economics (CDSE)
about: The University of Mannheim's Center for Doctoral Studies in Economics (CDSE) accepts applications to its doctoral program in economics for Fall 2027 until 31 March 2027. Applications received before 15 January 2027 are treated as early applications and reviewed first.
